content: At every follow-up visit, it is essential to inquire about the patient’s smoking history. Patients who smoke should be actively discouraged from continuing this habit, and healthcare providers should promote smoking cessation strategies to support them in quitting. The use of electronic cigarettes should also be strongly discouraged, as they pose potential health risks. Pediatric diabetes care teams should begin preparing adolescents for the transition to adult healthcare services, ideally starting this process during early adolescence. Healthcare providers must offer comprehensive support and resources to adolescents, young adults, and their families throughout the transition from pediatric to adult care. Collaboration between pediatric and adult diabetes care teams is crucial. These teams should work closely with patients and their caregivers to ensure a seamless and well-coordinated transition to adult healthcare services.
